buildCommand:
git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable /tmp/flutter && export PATH="$PATH:/tmp/flutter/bin" && flutter config --enable-web && printf 'SUPABASE_URL=%s
SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=%s
GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID=%s
PYTHON_API_URL=%s
' "$SUPABASE_URL" "$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" "$GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID" "$PYTHON_API_URL" > ../../.env && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
